def overlaps(self, other: "Session") -> bool:
        """True when the two sessions' time intervals overlap on the same day.
        Overlap requires that the sessions share the same day and that their
        time intervals intersect with a non‑zero duration (touching end/start is
        not considered an overlap)."""
        if self.day != other.day:
            return False
        # Use strict inequality to exclude back‑to‑back sessions.
        return self.start_minutes < other.end_minutes and other.start_minutes < self.end_minutes
